purpose: Provenance index for the manuscript's saved PRISM results; generated from deposited run summaries.

reproduction.python_dependencies: Python standard library only for saved-table exports

recorded_model_identifiers.fine_tuned_e5: fold-specific E5 paths are recorded in run summaries; weights are not included here
recorded_model_identifiers.immutable_provider_model_revisions: Not recorded in the supplied run files

ranking.Hit@K: Per eligible conversation, 1 when at least one reference product ID occurs in the evaluated top K; aggregate is the mean over eligible conversations.
ranking.NDCG@K: Per-conversation discounted gain using the reference product IDs and evaluated ranking, normalized by ideal ranking; aggregate is the mean over eligible conversations.
ranking.MRR: Mean reciprocal rank of the first reference product in the evaluated ranking.
ranking.Search Hit Rate: Fraction of eligible conversations where the raw retrieved candidate IDs include a reference product.
ranking.Displayed Semantic Hit Rate: Fraction whose displayed products satisfy the semantic reference-match implementation; see evaluator source for model and threshold details.
ranking.four-fold summary: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation across the four fold-level scores, as in ranking_mean_sd.csv.

revision_outcomes.PRCR: Compliant event-follow-ups / observed follow-up event pairs.
revision_outcomes.SPVR: Stale-preference violation event-follow-ups / observed follow-up event pairs.
revision_outcomes.Unknown: Unverifiable event-follow-ups / observed follow-up event pairs.
revision_outcomes.coverage: Observed follow-up recommendation events / 370 PRISM-derived reference revision events.
revision_outcomes.follow_up_rule: First logged recommendation strictly after the revision turn; retained sets count when logged as recommended.
revision_outcomes.limitations: Proxy scoring, not independent human adjudication of all baseline outputs; see the Metrics and interpretation limits section in the root README.

external_catalog_diagnostics.implementation: code/external_catalog/diagnose.py; same logic is used by reproduce_saved_tables.py on saved JSONL.
external_catalog_diagnostics.interpretation: Automatic diagnostics only; not human relevance ground truth.

content.evaluation: External relevance requires independent judgments. PSCon exact-ID GT is not used.
content.replay_limitation: User ordinal references/acceptance were collected in another recommendation trajectory.

known_provenance_limits: Main-run package/dependency versions and hardware are not consistently recorded in the saved run summaries.
Provider model revision identifiers and API request-level settings are not present in the supplied logs.
The external-run manifest records package versions and effective environment; see its embedded record.
PRCR/SPVR is a reference-based proxy with thresholds and known limitations documented in the root README; it is not independent human adjudication of every baseline event.
Amazon Reviews 2023-derived catalog snapshots are rights-review pending and must not be redistributed unless cleared.
